preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input grid has exactly n rows, each with exactly m characters ('W' or 'B').
Grid dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'W', 'B'} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either 'W' (white) or 'B' (black).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimal total cost.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= cost <= 10**6 for cost in [1, 2, 3, 4]) and sum(costs) == int(stdout) if (costs := [1, 2, 3, 4]) else True
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of costs (1, 2, 3, or 4 coins) for a sequence of operations that transforms the all-white grid to the target grid.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == min(total_cost for total_cost in possible_costs) if (possible_costs := [sum(costs) for costs in valid_operation_sequences()]) else True
postconditions.description: The output is the minimal possible total cost achievable by any sequence of operations (subrectangle flips with costs 1, 2, 3, or 4) that transforms the all-white grid to the target grid.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= y2 <= m for op in operations if (x1, y1, x2, y2 := op['rect']) and (x1, y1) in {(1, 1), (n, 1), (1, m), (n, m)}) if (operations := valid_operation_sequences()) else True
postconditions.description: Each operation in the sequence is a valid subrectangle flip containing one of the four corner cells (1,1), (n,1), (1,m), or (n,m), with cost 1, 2, 3, or 4 respectively.
